              ∀ cfg prs,
                ownSlice ops fs dq ∗ I fs.length cfg prs -∗ Φ ((intoVal cfg, intoVal prs), intoVal GoInterface.nil)) -∗
            WP (((intoVal (functions confchange.chain [])) (intoVal chg)) (intoVal ops)) {{ Φ }}
